claims.evidence: The origin of the import cannot be determined from static photos of the engine.
There is no video of the engine running or a diagnostic report.
Requires a video with audio of the engine running to verify the absence of mechanical knocking.
No odometer reading or ECU data is provided in the report.
Close-up photos of factory seals and bolt heads on the head/sump are missing.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure (seized or damaged pistons/valves).
risks.proof: A video showing the crankshaft being rotated manually or the engine running.
risks.if_unproven: As a non-functional unit for parts/scrap only.

risks.risk: Incorrect model or displacement for the buyer's vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine code or serial number stamped on the engine block.
risks.if_unproven: As the lowest-value Porsche engine variant of that physical configuration.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged wiring harness and electronic sensors.
risks.proof: A comprehensive photo showing the full wiring loom and all connector points.
risks.if_unproven: As a bare long block without electronics.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the engine code/serial number stamped on the block.
A video of the engine starting and running, or at least being turned over.
Close-up photos of the intake and exhaust ports to check for carbon buildup or oil.
Photos of the ECU and the complete wiring harness if included.
response.reason: The specific Porsche engine model and displacement are not identified. Without the engine code, it is impossible to determine which vehicle it fits or establish a baseline price.
